h1: Bengaluru se Delhi jaana tha... par ye kya?! Train toh ulti chal rahi hai, Kanyakumari ki taraf! Engine sabse peeche hai!
h2: Oracle jaise interviews mein pucha gaya ye sawaal: LeetCode two oh six, Reverse Linked List!
p1: Har dabba agle dabbe se juda hai: yahi hai linked list! Head pehla dabba, aur har dabbe ka next, agla dabba. Humein saare links ulte karne hain!
p2: Teen pointer lo: prev, curr, aur next. Prev shuru mein null, curr head pe.
p3: Ab har dabbe pe sirf chaar kaam: next ko bachao... curr ka link ulta karo, prev ki taraf... prev ko aage badhao... aur curr ko next pe le jao!
p4: Dabba ek: link null ki taraf! Dabba do: link ek ki taraf! Teen... chaar... aur engine: link chaar ki taraf! Curr null ho gaya, ruk jao. Prev hi naya head hai: engine!
p5: Bas ek loop: O of n time, O of one space! Aur dekho... train ab Delhi ki taraf!
p6: Ek line mein yaad rakho: next bachao, link palto, aage badho! Save karo, aur follow karo!
